title: Zesty Smoky Greek Banana Skewers
description: A playful twist on Greek souvlaki, these smoky banana skewers are brushed with lemony oregano oil, lightly panko-crusted, and grilled to a caramelized finish, served chilled on a slate tile for a refreshing solo dinner.
instructions: Preheat a charcoal grill to medium-high and oil the grates.
Slice the bananas lengthwise into ½ inch thick pieces.
In a small bowl whisk olive oil, lemon juice, lemon zest, smoked paprika, oregano, salt, and pepper to make a glaze.
Brush each banana slice with the glaze, making sure to coat both sides.
Toss the glazed banana slices in panko breadcrumbs until evenly coated.
Thread 2 banana slices onto each skewer, alternating if desired.
Place the skewers on the grill and cook for 2-3 minutes per side, until the panko turns golden and the banana softens slightly.
Remove the skewers and let them rest for a minute on a cooling rack.
Spoon a small amount of Greek yogurt onto each skewer as a creamy dip.
Serve immediately on a chilled slate tile for a smoky, crunchy solo dinner.
